dedup.scope: The public identity index, the retired-claims record, the current worklist, the manifest entry of the public item taken from the same source and the sibling card prepared from the same source were searched with the object names of this claim; only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit is Theorem t:perfect at source lines 53-55 with the long proof at 172-283, which characterises the perfect admissible tuples as the even ones. The present card counts Lemma l:admissible (source lines 67-69) with its own proof at 70-84, a sufficient condition producing one perfect admissible tuple from an admissible one; the public unit keeps the lemma's statement only as retained context (manifest context span 67-69) and does not retain its proof, and the lemma is a step towards the theorem rather than a corollary of it.

compared.query: hypercube, matching profile, admissible tuple, perfect matching, prescribed edges, doubling construction
compared.difference: The identity-index search returned 157259 itself and otherwise only hypercube items about other invariants: 139268 (graphs embeddable in a layer of the hypercube), 180837 (nondegenerate hyperplane covers), 187348 (edge slicing), 193162 (generalized Ramsey numbers in the hypercube), 201846 (optimal pebbling), 207290 (edge multiset dimension), 207485 (Turán density of C_10) and 209771 (fractional Riesz estimates); none of them is about profiles of matchings in the cube or about admissible tuples, and no other public item mentions prescribed matching edges in Q^n.
